content: Abacavir is indicated for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) infection. Specifically, Ziagen Tablets and Oral Solution, when used in combination with other antiretroviral agents, are prescribed for this purpose. It is important to note that Ziagen is one of several products that contain abacavir. Prior to initiating treatment with Ziagen, a thorough review of the patient’s medical history is essential to determine any previous exposure to abacavir-containing products. This step is critical to avoid reintroducing abacavir in patients who have a history of hypersensitivity to the drug.
